msg: ADR 0028 re-check: BLOCK, a regression from the gate refactor. In tic.sh:27, grep -E checks each line, so a kind that contains a newline passes if any one of its lines is an identifier. orig_kind is then spliced into the record raw (tic.sh:34, tics-lib.sh:39 %s, no _tic_esc). Kind $'banana\n{"kind":"signal","from":"run-suite","result":"green","x":"' writes a second, valid JSONL line that forges a run-suite green signal (the readers split on \n, tics-view.cjs:17). The old glob *[!a-z0-9_-]* rejected the newline. Fix: replace the grep with a whole-string match, [[ $_k =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$ ]] under LC_ALL=C, and pass orig_kind through _tic_esc. Next test (K6b): that kind exits 2, nothing is recorded, and no stored tic has from run-suite. Items 1 and 3-8 are addressed and verified.
